mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to higher borrowing costs and reduced consumer and business spending, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE is below 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates expanding economic activity and positive sentiment, leading to increased demand for housing and related goods, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases when HOUST increases by >5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production suggests reduced economic activity, leading to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when INDPRO declines by >1%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising employment and low unemployment indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth and increased retail sales indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases when GDPC1 and RSAFS increase, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of low interest rates combined with strong GDP growth creates a favorable environment for equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low interest rate regime with strong GDP growth
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS is low and GDPC1 is growing, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates in combination with falling unemployment rates indicate a tightening labor market, which may lead to inflationary pressures and negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, the hypothesis is rejected.
